title: Interpolation results spread
description: The Marzari-Vanderbilt spread of the model's Wannier functions at the gauge it was built with, in bohr and bohr squared. Omega_I is reported always; the rest whenever the record carries the neighbour overlaps that define it and the mesh has no two-point axis — the projection gauge has a spread too, and a driver comparing two models wants it either way.

gauge_invariant_bohr_squared.description: Omega_I: the part of the spread the gauge cannot change. From the spread when it was evaluated, otherwise from the subspace iteration when there was one; zero for an isolated manifold without overlaps.

localized.description: Whether the gauge was rotated by the spread minimiser at all.

total_bohr_squared.description: Omega = Omega_I + Omega_D + Omega_OD at the final gauge.

guiding_centers.description: What fixed the branch of each Berry phase: "trial orbitals" when the record carries their positions, "projection gauge" otherwise.

trial_orbital_centers_bohr.description: The record's trial-orbital positions, Cartesian bohr, one [x, y, z] per function; empty when it carries none.

initial_minimizable_bohr_squared.description: Omega_D + Omega_OD at the projection gauge, before any rotation: what localisation bought is this minus the final value.

centers_bohr.description: The Wannier centres at the final gauge, Cartesian bohr, one [x, y, z] per function.

spreads_bohr_squared.description: Omega_n per function: <r^2>_n - |<r>_n|^2, summing to the total.

localization_iterations.description: How many iterations the spread minimiser ran; present when it ran.

localization_converged.description: Whether the minimiser reached a stationary gauge rather than merely stopped; false after a stall, where the gauge is the best one found but not a minimum.

localization_gradient_norm.description: The norm of the spread gradient where the minimiser stopped, a diagnostic beside the answer rather than the convergence test.
